alt.en: The source has three readings: color state [a,0], key state [0,a], and punctuation state [0,0]. Only the final context reaches the baseline decoder, which makes four target predictions, ending with EOS.
alt.zh-hans: 源序列读三步：颜色状态 [a,0]、钥匙状态 [0,a]、句号状态 [0,0]。基线解码器只接收最终上下文，再预测四个目标 token，以 EOS 结束。

caption.en: Figure 13.1 — Three source readings feed one summary into four target predictions.
caption.zh-hans: 图 13.1 — 源序列读三步，交出一个摘要，目标序列预测四步。

credit.zh-hans: 本书原创教学图，数值为给定值或按规则推导值，CC BY-SA 4.0；未复制论文图示。

flow.en: ReLU recurrence; a = ln(2). Earlier states are not handed to the baseline writer.
flow.zh-hans: ReLU 递归，a = ln(2)。基线写出过程拿不到较早的状态。

text.en: Separate decoder parameters, shared in time
text.zh-hans: 解码器参数独立，沿时间共享

flow.en: This row shows the required target path, not a measured prediction trace. Stop after predicting EOS.
flow.zh-hans: 本行画的是要求的目标路径，不是实测预测轨迹。预测 EOS 后停止。
